::: {.why}
The last of the price-based time-series signals, and the one that connects directly to phase 8, because the thing being priced is the same in both places.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Report the forward return by volatility level and by volatility change, and say why the two differ.
- Say what a volatility-scaled position rule does that a volatility signal does not.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Evaluate both cross-sectionally and as a time-series rule: volatility level as a signal, volatility change as a signal, and volatility as a position scalar rather than a forecast. The third is not a signal at all, it is a sizing rule, and separating the three is the exercise.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [20 min]{.task-min} Connect it forward: the variance risk premium is the gap between implied and realised volatility, which is a time-series signal you cannot build until phase 8. Write down what data you would need and what the trade would be, so that week 40 has a specification to test rather than a topic.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Generate the pages for the time-series signals and add them to the book.
:::
:::
